signIn.title: Sign in to the staff console
signIn.invalid: That email and password don't match.

notStaff.title: Not a staff account
notStaff.description: This account is not on the Yayatoh staff list, or can't do that. Ask the platform owner if you need access.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Every organization on the platform. Each view is recorded in the access log.

done.paused: Paused. It applies to the organizer's next request.

switches.title: Kill switches
switches.description: Pausing takes effect on the organizer's next request. The organizer sees what is paused, not your reason.

flow.platform_mor: Orders are charged by the platform (platform_mor).
flow.organizer_mor: Orders are charged on the connected account (organizer_mor).

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.note: Debits are positive. Organizer payables are negative: money owed to the organizer.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.summary: Summary for the card network (what was bought, that it was delivered or used)

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Open differences between this tenant's ledger and the payment provider's balance transactions (daily run). Resolve with a note once explained; the note is audited.

accessLog.title: Access log
accessLog.description: Every cross-tenant read by staff and the worker, newest first (latest 200).

evidence.title: Dispute evidence · {id}
evidence.subtitle: Prepared for the card network by {seller} and Yayatoh
evidence.footer: Generated from Yayatoh records: orders, tickets and check-in scans. Reviewed by a person before submission.
evidence.soldByPlatform: Pani Digital Services, LLC (Yayatoh), on behalf of the organizer
evidence.noRefunds: No refunds were requested for this order.
evidence.noPolicy: The organizer has not published a refund policy.
evidence.noScans: No door scans were recorded for these tickets.
evidence.noMessages: No messages were sent to the buyer about this order.
evidence.trimmed: {n, plural, one {# more row left out} other {# more rows left out}} to stay within the card networks’ page limit.

commission.title: Commission
commission.description: Platform fees per organization and currency, from the ledger: fees on sales (online and box office) minus fees given back by refunds. Days are in UTC.
commission.badRange: The end date is before the start date. Showing this month instead.
commission.badDate: Pick both dates. Showing this month instead.
commission.empty: No platform fees in this period.

apiUsage.title: API usage by app version
apiUsage.description: Requests to /v1 per route, client and app version over the last 7 days (UTC). No organization or person is recorded.
apiUsage.summary: {versions, plural, =0 {No client versions seen yet.} one {# client version seen.} other {# client versions seen.}}
apiUsage.empty: No /v1 requests recorded in the last 7 days.
